electrical_source.observation: Groner etal2002 measured ALD30-3540Angstrom films. Typical12nm sample leakage<1nA/cm2 at2MV/cm and breakdown>=5MV/cm; thick-film dielectricconstant~7.6. This supports plausibility of isolating~22V across100nm, but does not qualify our9-permittivity metal/oxide/metal stack at343K, higharea and repeatedcycling.

thermal_source.observation: 2020JAP127245105 measured17-119.4nm ALDAl2O3 films, k=1.73+/-0.08W/mK at300K, stackTBR2.1-3.7e-8m2K/W on different substrates. These put100nm addedthermal resistance~1e-7m2K/W, far below photon-port1/h~2e-4m2K/W. ActualFE/metal/oxide bond stillrequiresitsown thermalresponse; no repeatedcycle qualification inferred.

optical_warning: Inherited45nmSiC ports assume PEC-backed opticalfilm. A10nm isolatedbackmetal is not established as PEC, and its finite sheetadmittance may alterheatrouting. Actualnewbackmetal must preserveopticalimpedance orheatcontacts/comparator must berecomputed.
